# The target organizational unit

**Nothing to do here.** This bundle names an existing OU, ou-exam-research1, and every
file in it is ready to apply as written. This file is included so the bundle has
the same five files every time; jump to `README.md`.

For reference, the delegation is scoped to:

```
organization o-exampleorgid
  management account 111111111111
    OU ou-exam-research1        <- the delegated subtree
      (vended accounts land here)
```
